notes.title: Patch Update – Mage Achievement Bug Fixed!
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!

We have identified and fixed an issue where the "Mage" achievement was not unlocking correctly. This issue has now been resolved, and you should be able to obtain the achievement as intended.

If you have previously tried to unlock the achievement without success, please update your game and try again.

Thank you for your patience and support! If you encounter any other issues, feel free to share your feedback in the community discussions.

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Demo Update – New Improvements and Checkpoints!
notes.content:
Dear players,
We are excited to announce that the demo version of Damsels in Distress has received an important update!

Here’s what’s new:

Checkpoints (intermediate saves) have been added for a smoother and more comfortable gameplay experience.
QTEs (Quick Time Events) have been improved — they are now more responsive and dynamic.
Additional changes have been made to make the game even more engaging and enjoyable.
We also have some exciting news:
The full version of Damsels in Distress is almost ready and will be released within the next couple of months! Stay tuned for more updates.

Try out the updated demo now and share your thoughts in the comments! Your support and feedback mean the world to us.
